body.statement: For the two-period panel difference-in-differences model under conditional parallel trends and overlap, Sant'Anna and Zhao's Proposition 1(a), equations (2.11)--(2.12), give the semiparametric efficiency bound and the efficient influence function for the average treatment effect on the treated.

attestation.note: The stable DOI and corrected panel-specific proposition and equation locators are supplied in lieu of a verbatim source transcription.
